events.cadence: once after the final original-system residual passes; iteration zero is possible
events.residualBasis: original nondimensional full-system free-equation residual divided by the norm of raw reduced right-hand side

limitations: Declaration of implemented observation paths only; not execution permission or physical validation
Events and retained artifacts are not guaranteed: failures, zero iterations, retention limits and cancellation may omit them
Arnoldi estimates and restart residuals use a preconditioned system; only final-check reports the checked original-system relative residual
A converged numerical residual does not establish physical accuracy, flow balance or mesh independence
No intermediate Stokes velocity or pressure field arrays are retained
